title: Retake the Harbor
description: The bandits took the warehouses and left the strongboxes, which means they do not know the last of Larton's grain is behind those doors. They moved the week the guards were watching the bay. Get them out before somebody opens a sack.

objectives.description: Clear bandits from the occupied warehouse (0/4)
Defeat the Bandit Lieutenant holding the grain
Report to Captain Harken at the survivor hideout

notes: Threat named as Larton's post-blight grain, taken while the town's guard was watching the bay instead of the docks. Same regional crisis as starving_south, supply_line_crisis, aberdeen_relief - this is why Larton had nothing to send south. on_complete_flags unchanged.
